DLC2302:3:t_1:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...A prodigy at ten, a genius at fifteen, an ordinary man past twenty... The passage of time can be cruel.」

DLC2302:3:t_1:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How do those who achieve great things as boys grow up...?」

DLC2302:3:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The story I am about to tell takes place not long after $$サイデリアル$$ began its invasion.」

DLC2302:3:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thanks to the $$連邦軍$$ holding firm on the East Asian and $$新日本$$ fronts, Japan remained relatively peaceful.」

DLC2302:3:t_1:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But in every world and every age, there are always villains.」

DLC2302:3:t_1:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This is a story about brave boys who stand up to such evil.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:5.en:
$$ローレライ$$
「Please. Could you find our missing kitten?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:7.en:
$$マッキー$$
「Don't you want to, $$正太郎$$?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:9.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ and I could be called out at any moment...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:10.en:
$$シロー$$
「But my brother said he's leaving Japan's defense to you and $$ワッ太$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:12.en:
$$ローレライ$$
「Please, $$正太郎$$. I think the little kitten must have gotten lost and can't find its way back to its mother.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:13.en:
$$シロー$$
「$$ローレライ$$ and I have searched all over, but we just can't find it.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:14.en:
$$シロー$$
「At this point, we have to ask you for help. You are an $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ boy investigator, after all.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:16.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry, $$シロー$$. $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ will take that job.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:18.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$ isn't the only one on standby in Japan.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:19.en:
$$シロー$$
「But... are you sure, $$ワッ太$$?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:20.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Of course. $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ is the universe's all-purpose service company!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:21.en:
$$シロー$$
「But we can't afford to pay to send out $$トライダー$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:22.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry about that. We'll call this one volunteer work.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:23.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「With things the way they are, we're getting fewer jobs, so we're not busy anyway.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:24.en:
$$ローレライ$$
「Then please help us. Here's a drawing showing what the kitten looks like.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:25.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Got it. I'll find it by tomorrow.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:28.en:
$$シロー$$
「But isn't that good? $$ワッ太$$ seems eager to help.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:30.en:
$$シロー$$
「Do you mean you can't trust $$ワッ太$$ with it...?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:31.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's not it. ...But I've got a bad feeling...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:37.en:
$$木下$$
「It's a company-wide manhunt for $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$. Let's give it our all!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:38.en:
$$柿小路$$
「We are a business, not a $$ボランティア部$$...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:39.en:
$$厚井$$
「What's wrong with doing this once in a while, Executive Director? We haven't had any callouts lately.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:41.en:
$$厚井$$
「Well, I admit we don't need every employee to take part.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:42.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What are you talking about, $$鉄っつぁん$$? We don't have $$正太郎$$'s detective skills, so we've got to do the legwork and use our numbers!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:43.en:
$$加代$$
「Is that why you called us here, too?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:44.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Sorry, Mom. I wish I could have given you a trip to the hot springs instead...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:45.en:
$$加代$$
「It's fine. If $$シロー$$ and $$ローレライ$$ need help, lending them a hand is the decent thing to do.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:46.en:
$$サチ子$$
「But why didn't $$正太郎$$ want to look for the kitten?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:47.en:
$$しげる$$
「I've got it! $$正太郎$$ hates cats!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:48.en:
$$木下$$
「I suppose his pride as a boy investigator wouldn't let him do something as trivial as looking for a cat.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:49.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I really can't imagine $$正太郎$$ being like that...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:50.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Well, never mind. Let's find that kitten ourselves!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:54.en:
$$正太郎$$
（...If it were going to hide somewhere in $$熱海$$, I think it would be around here...）

DLC2302:3:t_2:58.en:
$$マッキー$$
「You don't have to look so surprised. I'm the one who told you where the kitten might be hiding.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:59.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$マッキー$$... Go home right now.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:60.en:
$$マッキー$$
「But $$ワッ太$$ has his whole company looking for the kitten. You can't do it all alone either...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:61.en:
$$正太郎$$
「That's not the problem. Right now, here in $$熱海$$...」

DLC2302:3:t_2:63.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「You noticed our movements, did you?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:64.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$ブランチ$$ members! I knew you were hiding in $$熱海$$!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:65.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Don't try anything funny.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:66.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「If you resist, we'll fill your cute little girlfriend full of holes.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:69.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Ha ha ha! We've endured our time in hiding, but it looks like the wind is finally at our backs.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:70.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「If we get $$鉄人$$'s $$Ｖコン$$ in exchange for this little girl, we could conquer Japan.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:71.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「The super robot forces aren't here, either. They're busy fighting the $$新地球皇国$$.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:73.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「Give up, $$金田正太郎$$. Now you're no different from any other helpless child!」

DLC2302:3:t_2:74.en:
？？？
「You're playing awfully dirty against that child, aren't you?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:76.en:
$$安$$
「You boys sure make yourselves at home on someone else's turf without even paying your respects.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:78.en:
$$ブランチ$$ Member
「What can some hot-spring inn employee do!?」

DLC2302:3:t_2:79.en:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「You lot must be bottom of the underworld barrel.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:80.en:
$$クロス$$
「Hiding in $$熱海$$ without even knowing about $$くろがね屋$$? Unbelievable.」

DLC2302:3:t_2:81.en:
$$お菊$$
「They're just small-time punks hoping to loot in the chaos... This is about what I'd expect.」

review.context: Watta accepts a missing-kitten search that Shotaro hesitates over because he suspects Branch criminals in Atami. Makki follows Shotaro into danger, and the Kurogane-ya staff intervene against the hostage-takers.
decisions: The opening proverb preserves the age progression rather than implying literal loss of ability.
Yasu's turf/respects language retains his gangster register.
The hostage threat retains the explicit shooting threat.
Tetsu is Atsui's familiar nickname; the exact nickname token is retained.
Caption repair preserves the source blank header, blank lines, indentation and fullwidth wave decorations; the translated location remains in the body.
